what_happened: This user set up an SEO autopilot to track AI-generated content, analyze search engine results, and identify areas for improvement. The autopilot tracked how AI models answer questions, researched keywords, wrote and scored articles, and scheduled them on a calendar. It also provided Search Console data to prove outcomes. The user was able to monitor their AI-visibility summary, track prompts, and view Search Console proof. This job is a public pattern.
